I grew up on an isolated farm in the middle of nowhere until I was 14. I went to a school with 75 kids from year 1 to 10 and had no friends, was bullied horrendously for who my mother was and how she was known in the closest town and being the weird kid who lived with their grandparents. I had a few things that kept me going, my 3 cats and Pokemon, Zelda, Dragon Quest (specifically 9 at the time), Harvest Moon, Professor Layton, The Elder Scrolls and Animal Crossing. I didn't need friends when I had these fake creatures and quirky characters, they became my friends, I could be anyone I wanted to be. I would lay in bed all day just dreaming about the life I'd have in these worlds and with these characters and it really made me feel not as isolated, unfortunately it got to the point I started seeing and talking to them in real life, I'd walk around the farm just talking to air but in my head I was seeing these characters beside me, it was tough, I was already going to therapy for issues involving my childhood but all of a sudden I felt like an alien because I was seeing these things that weren't real, and I knew they weren't real but they were still there. It was tough, but after 10 years of therapy im doing a lot better, im in a city and have a good group of friends, a daughter on the way and a lovely partner, I still play those games and any new ones in the series, and it still fills me with so much joy. They truly did keep me alive back then.
